scientific_integrity: Finite independent enumeration is a stress check, not the proof; previously known chromatic-palette, one-extra-colour and bipartite formula regimes are expressly excluded from novelty claims.
scientific_limitations: Complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts and palettes with at least two surplus colours; no general graphs, no unique-extension classification, and no claim of an independent review. General proof covers arbitrary finite part sizes and palette sizes. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Forced-colouring polynomials of complete multipartite graphs beyond one extra colour
